ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity black pixels covering approximately 95% of the visible surface, punctuated by high-intensity white point-source pixels creating a high-contrast speckled distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous black pigmentation across both lobes. Numerous discrete, high-contrast white circular focal spots (mottling) are stochastically distributed across the 2D surface, with clusters concentrated near the trailing edges and central lower region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a central vertex and an approximate 75-degree internal angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations (jagged peaks and shallow valleys) detected along the entire distal margin of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory from the median notch extending laterally, flattening toward the distal tips with a slight downward curve at the extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially dense clusters of circular white pixel groups, particularly visible on the inner trailing edges of both lobes and scattered across the lateral surfaces.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Widespread circular scarring patterns (white pixels on black background) distributed across the ventral surface, likely resulting from parasitic colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: A small, irregular high-intensity white patch is visible at the basal insertion point of the fluke where it meets the water line.
